items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled lemma at source lines 444-446 (book Theorem 6.4.1): the generating loop of the circle is not equal to the reflexivity path at its base point. The statement is a single disequality and the proof (source lines 447-452) has to manufacture the contradiction: it assumes the equality, then uses the recursion principle of the circle to transport that assumption to an arbitrary type carrying an arbitrary loop, concluding that every loop of every type is trivial and therefore that every type is a set, which contradicts the universe not being one. The step from a triviality of one loop to a global triviality of loops is the substance, and the statement contains none of it.
